name: PassiveSpellModifierPlan (selected SpellMod compiler)
semantic_facts: only activation is SpellModifierActivation::SelectedTrait (data/src/action/catalog/spell_modifier.rs:11-13); value/selector/operation come from the selected package role, never re-read from authored points

operations: raw-108/218 misc0 0->Direct, 22->Periodic, 15->CriticalBonus, 11->Cooldown, 3->PercentFirstEffect; raw-107/219 misc0 3->FlatFirstEffect, 11->FlatCooldown (selected_trait_package.rs:1033-1098)
class-mask selector: raw-107/108 with misc1==0 and nonempty effect mask; label selector: raw-218/219 with misc1 label and empty effect mask
applicability count: class mask = popcount of overlap within equal nonzero family (GameData::effect_spell_match_count), label = Boolean (spell_has_label)

Percent ops: factor = binary32 (1+p/100)^count per payload (spellmod_percent_factor :477-483); flat ops: points*count (:596, :673); PercentFirstEffect: factor 1+p/100 applied once if count>0 (:544, :574)
owner: nonzero family for class-mask, neutral defense/dispel/mechanics, empty owner class mask (validate_owner :950-988) plus selected_trait_owner_policy_issue

name: SpellModifierAuthority (actor-bound SpellMod aggregation)
semantic_facts: Player-only bindings; duplicate (actor,effect) bindings rejected (:110-121)

factors grouped by (actor,payload,operation) with CooldownFlat folded into Cooldown coordinate (:21-28); percent terms combine as binary32 products in canonical exact-effect order (:375-377); flat cooldown ms checked-add
flat first-effect points grouped by (actor,target effect), checked-add

name: SpellMod runtime consumers (damage/healing/critical/first-effect/cooldown)
semantic_facts: damage/heal route Direct->op0 projection, Periodic/PeriodicLeech->op22, PeriodicPercent (raw 20) and Other->none
op15 excess scaling 1+(M-1)F applied to any crit-eligible impact (heal or damage) whose payload spell has a CriticalBonus projection
first-effect flat then percent factor applied to raw-20 periodic percent heal (Player self only); raw-87 damage-taken first effect receives flat points only (holder==source==affected)
cooldown SpellMod (flat ms, binary32 factor) looked up by (actor, activation spell) at quote, commit and action-change

name: Cooldown SpellMod start duration (spell_modified_base_duration)
semantic_facts: (base + flat) then *binary32 factor, truncated once, nonpositive -> Suppressed; applied to every private and shared deadline binding of the initiating activation before haste/rate scaling and before raw-341 flat
DeadlineRecovery.base_duration retains the unmodified base (semantics equality only)

name: CooldownModifierPlan root
semantic_facts: composes raw-286 ordinary rate, raw-148 charge rate, raw-341/453/454/205 duration, raw-457 haste regeneration and raw-411 capacity children; each child independently optional

name: authored cooldown ops (grant charges / reset cooldown)
semantic_facts: GrantCharges binds charge category; ResetCooldown binds resolved target; no amount facts consumed

name: CooldownAdjustment compiler (ReduceRemainingCooldown / ModifyCooldownsByCategory)
semantic_facts: authored integral base points -> Reduce/None/Extend ms; neutral amount facts required; AP/SP coefficients rejected

triggered spell: private+shared (excluding start-recovery category) + charge category of the trigger action; category: every private deadline of actions whose ordinary category==misc0 plus that shared category once; conflicting non-member starter rejected
misc must be neutral for triggered form; category form requires empty class mask, neutral mechanic/radius

name: CooldownRecoveryRatePlan (raw 286)
semantic_facts: authored base points (aura activation only); misc0/misc1 must be 0; exact caster delivery; application mutation must target caster; Passive/AsyncStacking owners rejected
applicability: GameData::effect_affects_spell (family 0 universal, empty mask = whole family, else any-word overlap) - Boolean, matches Trinity SpellInfo::IsAffected
cells bind every private/shared deadline with a start of each affected action

name: cooldown_start carrier audit
semantic_facts: exact-carrier source audit (pinned 12.0 base points, Shadow melee owner) for main-hand swing reset on launch; no SpellMod/label/mask applicability

name: ChargeCapacityPlan (raw 411)
semantic_facts: exact Second Helping 1239537:1 contract: base points bit-equal +1, category 2409 exact, charge pool 1 charge/fixed/snapshot; empty effect and owner class masks

name: ChargeDurationModifierPlan (raw 453/454/205)
semantic_facts: Passive activation only; authored base points; 453 flat / 454 percent on exact category misc0; 205 only for Swift Justice effect 1 with type mask 32
percentage owner must be sole-effect; misc1 == 0; Swift Justice requires exact-effect attribute IgnoreDuringCooldownTimeRateCalculation which the charge consumer does not consult

name: charge_modification compiler (ImmediateCooldownRechargeCategory)
semantic_facts: authored integral base points become a signed charge delta for the misc0 charge category

name: ChargeRechargeRatePlan (raw 148)
semantic_facts: aura-activated authored percent; misc0 = charge category, misc1 == 0, empty class mask; speed max(1+p*stacks/100, 0.01)

name: ChargeRecoveryHastePlan (raw 457)
semantic_facts: exact Umbral Blade 1272842:1 contract selecting category 2409; amount facts ignored; empty class mask

name: CategoryDurationPlan (raw 341)
semantic_facts: Passive activation; authored integral signed ms; misc0 ordinary category, misc1 0; applies after haste/rate to private starts and to shared start of the same category

name: duration_modifier_source shared static validator
semantic_facts: neutral mechanic, empty class mask, zero AP/SP, neutral amount/chain facts, self target, no radius, restricted exact attributes, integral ms

name: DamageModifier compiler
semantic_facts: authored base points; AuraSource scope rejects nonempty class mask while AuraSourceAffectList expands payloads by effect_affects_spell (Boolean IsAffected semantics)

name: HealingModifier compiler
semantic_facts: aura activation uses authored base points; SelectedTraitPassive/Passive skipped here (owned by passive_healing_received); affect-list scope expands via effect_affects_spell

name: TargetAuraStateModifier compiler
semantic_facts: exact provider/marker contract with pinned percent points; family NONE and empty owner class mask required

name: DispelDurationModifier compiler
semantic_facts: exact provider/applicand relation with pinned points (bit-equal), empty family ownership / mask checks

name: MechanicDurationModifier compiler
semantic_facts: exact carrier contracts (55366, 60209) with bit-equal points; mechanic selection from subtype/misc; family NONE, empty masks

name: OutgoingMechanicModifierPlan
semantic_facts: bit-equal expected percentage points; empty effect and owner class masks

name: ModifierPlan root (program/modifier.rs + submodules)
semantic_facts: owns payload spell sets for SpellMod ops: direct (DirectDamage/Area/HealthLeech/DirectHeal/DirectPercentHeal/MissingOrMax), periodic (PeriodicDamage/PeriodicHeal/PeriodicHealthLeech), critical = programs with crit-eligible impact having damage

name: Cooldown recovery-rate / charge duration runtime
semantic_facts: ordinary: truncate(base / haste / rate_speed).max(1); charge: truncate((base+flat)*pct / haste / speed).max(1) in f64
charge Reduce recovers floor-counted charges and keeps residual (Trinity pops every RechargeEnd<now entry)
